/ego_vehicle_adapter:

    allow_reverse: false
    footprint_source: LOCKED_URDF_OR_DEPLOYMENT_DUMP_REQUIRED

    grid_unknown_is_occupied: true
    inflate_radius_m: 0.0

    map_resolution_m: 0.3
    max_accel_mps2: 0.85
    max_curvature_1pm: 0.0

    max_jerk_mps3: 0.0

    max_yaw_accel_rps2: 1.4
    max_yaw_decel_rps2: 1.8

    measured_wheel_radius_m: PENDING
    output_topic: /research/ego_trajectory
    planning_acceleration_fraction: 0.5
    planning_speed_fraction: 0.8
    qos_overrides:
      /clock:
        subscription:
          depth: 1
          durability: volatile
          history: keep_last
          reliability: best_effort
      /parameter_events:
        publisher:
          depth: 1000
          durability: volatile
          history: keep_last
          reliability: reliable
    state_timeout_s: 0.2
    use_sim_time: true
